segments.title: A tab group's box sits even
segments.body: Point at a tab group, then at its last tab. The box now sits as close under the last tab as it does over the group's name. 0.2.44-nightly.1 left an extra 2 pt of box below the last tab, so the bottom looked loose next to the top and sides.

segments.title: Muted tabs stay quiet
segments.body: Pinecone is muted, in the background. A message arrives and the site sends a notification. Ardia now hands it to macOS without a sound. 0.2.44-nightly.1 muted the tab's audio but still asked macOS to play the alert sound. The banner is drawn from what Ardia sent to macOS: a hidden test window can't show real ones.
